2610.08250.title: MASC: A Multi-Agent Self-Calibration Framework with Latent Construct Alignment for Consistent Client Role-Playing in Psychological Counseling
2610.08250.paper_summary: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate clients for counselor training and psychological counseling research, but reliable simulation requires clients to remain psychologically coherent across extended interactions. Existing role-playing methods largely rely on static profile prompts and may exhibit persona drift, unrealistic cooperativeness, or inconsistent psychological states, communicative actions, and emotions. Existing evaluations also lack a unified testbed for both stable client characteristics and evolving psychological dynamics. We propose MASC, a Multi-Agent Self-Calibration framework with latent construct alignment for consistent client role-playing in psychological counseling. MASC combines construct-guided generation, collaborative refinement, consistency verification, and memory-based revision in a closed calibration loop that detects and corrects inconsistencies as dialogue unfolds. We further introduce CRPC-Bench, a benchmark covering session-level profile information and Big-Five personality traits, as well as turn-level psychological state, communicative action, and emotion expression. CRPC-Bench contains 38 motivational interviewing client profiles augmented with personality and emotion annotations. Experiments show that MASC outperforms existing methods across profile, personality, receptivity, and turn-level consistency, with the heterogeneous configuration achieving the strongest overall performance. MASC and CRPC-Bench provide a unified foundation for developing and evaluating psychologically coherent client simulations for AI-assisted counseling research and training.
2610.08250.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型越來越多地用於模擬客戶，以進行輔導員訓練和心理諮詢研究，但可靠的模擬要求客戶在長時間的互動中保持心理上的一致性。現有的角色扮演方法主要依賴靜態的個人資料提示，可能會出現角色漂移、不切實際的合作性，或心理狀態、交流行為和情感的不一致。現有的評估也缺乏一個統一的測試平台，以同時評估穩定的客戶特徵和不斷演變的心理動態。我們提出了 MASC，一個多代理自我校準框架，具有潛在構念對齊，用於在心理諮詢中進行一致的客戶角色扮演。MASC 結合了構念引導生成、協作精煉、一致性驗證和基於記憶的修訂，形成一個封閉的校準迴路，能夠在對話展開時檢測和修正不一致之處。我們進一步介紹了 CRPC-Bench，一個基準，涵蓋了會話級別的個人資料信息和大五人格特質，以及回合級別的心理狀態、交流行為和情感表達。CRPC-Bench 包含 38 個動機訪談客戶檔案，並增強了人格和情感註釋。實驗顯示，MASC 在個人資料、人格、接受度和回合級別的一致性方面均優於現有方法，其中異質配置實現了最強的整體性能。MASC 和 CRPC-Bench 為開發和評估心理上連貫的客戶模擬提供了統一的基礎，適用於 AI 輔助的諮詢研究和訓練。
